_readme: When each scheduled job runs. Times are IST (Asia/Kolkata), standard 5-field cron: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week (0 or 7 = Sunday).
Read by .github/workflows/scheduler.yml, which wakes every hour and starts whichever jobs here are due (tools/watch/scheduler.py).
So the timing is data, not workflow code: edit this file (or use admin/schedules.html, which commits it) and the next hour's scheduler obeys it.
Granularity is the hour: a job set for 02:30 starts at the first scheduler wake-up after 02:30, usually within minutes, never earlier.
enabled=false pauses a job without deleting it. `inputs` are passed to the workflow exactly as typed in its 'Run workflow' form.

jobs.label: Weekly source watch (13 upstream sources, e-mail to superadmins)
Nightly reader-report sort, digest and reporter notices
Monthly padaccheda and sandhi rebuild (opens a pull request)
Nightly library sync (names audit, opens the library-sync pull request)
Weekly SEO pages build (deploys only if Pages is on Actions)
